subject: Post-demo: inference hosting posture & migration origins check-in
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos@opsml.com>, ops-team@opsml.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: inference hosting posture & migration origins check-in

Hi Carlos / Ops team,

Thanks again for the demo today — great conversation. Quick recap and a few asks so we can scope a tight pilot and suggest the right hosting lane.

Recap (high level):
- You're evaluating inference for a customer-facing vector search + summarization product (document ingestion + 1:1 chat).
- Primary concerns: predictable latency, cost per 1k queries, and data residency for PHI in QA region.
- Current stack: production traffic hitting LegacyCloudAI API + an older self-hosted GPU cluster for internal batch tasks.

Open asks that matter for mode recommendation (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private):
1) Expected steady-state qps and peak bursts (50k doc corpus vs per-user sessions) — a sample hour or peak day helps.
2) Latency SLO (p95): you mentioned ~200ms target for chat? please confirm.
3) Compliance boundary: which environments need VPC/on-prem & which can use hosted API?
4) Migration origin details: are you looking to cutover entirely off LegacyCloudAI, or keep hybrid traffic split initially?
5) Model families you plan to run (gpt-style 7B/13B, or customer-finetuned variants) and whether quantized variants are acceptable.

Next steps I propose:
- Can you share the short capacity snapshot you mentioned (token mix + qps by endpoint)? attaching a template (MAP-OpsML-template.xlsx) we use for pilots.
- Schedule a 45-min technical handoff with Karthik + our infra team to validate KV cache reuse and batching opportunities (that will strongly affect Dedicated vs Hosted economics).
- We can provision a small Dedicated baseline for a 2-week pilot and open a Private VPC option if you need stricter network isolation.

Attached: redwood-dedicated-sla.pdf (sample SLA), MAP-OpsML-template.xlsx (pilot intake).

If helpful I can propose two time slots next week for the tech call.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Aisha Rahman
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aisha@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0126

From: Carlos Mendez <carlos@opsml.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops-team@opsml.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: inference hosting posture & migration origins check-in

Aisha — thanks for the recap. This matches our notes. Quick answers inline: 

- Traffic: peak currently ~500 req/s for search/summarize endpoints during business hours (US east), steady-state ~120 req/s. We also run nightly batch document enrich (batch jobs hit self-hosted cluster).
- p95 target: 200ms for short-chat flows; 400ms acceptable for long-document summarize.
- Compliance: PHI lives in our QA and certain customer regions; those must be VPC-only. Non-PHI traffic can use hosted.
- Migration: goal is to move away from LegacyCloudAI entirely, but we expect a 6–8 week hybrid phase where both systems run in parallel.
- Models: mostly 13B variants, a small number of 70B experiments. We're open to quantized 13B in exchange for lower cost.

I attached the capacity snapshot (capacity-snapshot-opsml-202506.csv). Happy to do the tech call — Thurs 6/19 10am PT or Fri 6/20 1pm PT work.

Carlos
VP Product Operations, OpsML
carlos@opsml.com | +1 (312) 555-0987

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: aisha@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: inference hosting posture & migration origins check-in

Aisha / Ben — quick internal note before we lock times with Carlos: 

- The qps mix (500 peak / 120 steady) + p95 200ms suggests Dedicated could be economical if we can use batching + KV cache reuse for the summarize flows. 70B experiments push the memory requirements; recommend we clarify how often those run (ad-hoc vs production).
- Ask OpsML to provide token distribution (short chat vs doc summarize) and average generation length — that will change throughput math.
- Proposed play: run a 2-week Dedicated pilot (baseline node pool) + a locked Private VPC design doc for PHI segments if they sign. If hybrid cutover is planned for 6–8 weeks, we should include routing rules and fallback (Hosted for overflow).

I'll join the tech call and bring a short checklist for quantization compatibility and model artifact formats.

— Karthik
Director, Platform Solutions | Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos@opsml.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 18:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: inference hosting posture & migration origins check-in

Perfect — thanks Carlos. Thurs 6/19 10am PT works for us; I booked 45 minutes and sent a calendar invite.

Immediate asks for the tech call (please upload before the meeting if possible):
- capacity-snapshot-opsml-202506.csv (thanks for sending)
- token distribution by endpoint + avg generation length
- a short note on how you currently authenticate/rate-limit with LegacyCloudAI (API keys? per-org tokens?)

I'll bring the Dedicated baseline proposal and a Private VPC checklist. We'll also share an initial MAP doc after the call.

Attachments: MAP-OpsML-template.xlsx (pilot intake) — please fill the red fields.

See you Thu.

Best,
Aisha
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
